title: Top Sustainable Gifts 2024
summary: Shop our list of the best sustainable gifts for 2024, with ideas like carbon-negative coffee, sustainable yoga mats, and Allbirds organic cotton tote bags, shoes, or socks.
body_markdown:
Sustainable gifts are unique in that they show love for the recipient as well as our planet! From Allbirds shoes to wool blankets and eco-friendly cosmetics, give your loved ones a meaningful present that makes a positive impact far beyond the magical moment.


Use this list to support eco-friendly practices, renewable materials, and ethical craftsmanship in your gifting choices this year. Here are our picks for the best sustainable gifts of 2024.


[Allbirds Canvas Tote Bag](https://www.allbirds.com/products/canvas-tote-bag)


Travel, errands, working from a coffee shop—it’s all a little easier with this large canvas tote, made with our Organic cotton canvas blend. Measuring 18” across and 12.5” in height, this can haul it all without using harmful synthetic blends. Also available in a smaller[Mini Tote size](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mini-canvas-tote-bag) .


[The Peep Show Birdhouse with camera](https://www.thepeepshow.com/)


This Seattle-based company has created birdhouses with ornithological standards in mind (basically, whatever the birds need to live their best life within!), and they’re equipped with cameras so that you can watch your bird family grow and thrive. Each one is made from Western red cedar wood, and the wood surfaces inside the nest are intentionally left rough so the fledglings can climb out for their first flight. How sweet is that!


[Eighth Generation Blankets & Housewares](https://eighthgeneration.com/)


Eighth Generation is an art and lifestyle company that partners with Native artists around the country to design and create beautiful[wool blankets](https://eighthgeneration.com/collections/blankets/products/ancestral-echoes-wool-blanket) and incredible gifts, from kitchenware to jewelry and fine art prints—all produced with carefully-sourced materials and a passion for protecting the earth.


[Allbirds Weather-Ready Wool Shoes](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/womens-mizzles)


Speaking of wool as a renewable material, we can’t leave our Wool Mizzles off this list! Our water-repellent wool sneakers keep feet warm and dry in unpredictable weather, using materials like renewable merino wool and sugarcane, which is used in our SweetFoam® sole. Even the laces are made from recycled polyester (1 pair = 1 plastic water bottle). If you have someone who likes to take walks, stay cozy, or just be[comfortable walking around in their own home](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/best-shoes-for-being-indoors) , the[Wool Mizzles for women](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-runner-mizzles) and[for men](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-runner-mizzles) are a solid gift choice.


[Bennd Yoga Mats](https://www.benndyoga.com/pages/ayurvedic-yoga-mat-collection)


Get bendy! Made with raw, ethically sourced materials like organic cotton and natural latex, Bennd mats are naturally antibacterial, antimicrobial, and hypoallergenic. Perfect for the yogi in your life (or yourself!).


[Allbirds socks & tees](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/anytime-socks)


Do you know what your t-shirts are made of? Give the gift of smooth, durable everyday t-shirts and breathable socks that you know are designed with renewable materials. They feel luxuriously soft and won’t stretch or wear out like other materials. Love, love!


Our t-shirts ([women’s](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/womens-tops) and[men’s](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/mens-tops-collection) ) are made with a blend of organic cotton, merino wool, and Tencel™ Lyocell, which is a tree-based fiber that uses 95% less water than conventional cotton and has a carbon footprint that is one-third lower than virgin nylon. Plus, they’re amazingly smooth to the touch! Maybe that’s the way the planet smiles back.


[Allbirds socks](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/anytime-socks) come in crew, ankle, and no-show styles, and are made with materials like organic cotton, tree fiber, and merino wool. If you’re looking for a gift for someone who has everything, our[cozy crew socks](https://www.allbirds.com/products/trino-cozy-crew-sailor-blue) are just made for sitting by the fire!


Thank you for shopping sustainably, and happy gifting!
